008package paint.ui.dialogs.project;
009
010import paint.shared.config.paintconfig.PaintConfig;
011
012import javax.swing.*;
013import javax.swing.border.TitledBorder;
014import java.awt.*;
015
016import static paint.shared.constants.PaintStringConstants.NUMBER_OF_SQUARES_IN_RECORDING;
017import static paint.shared.constants.PaintStringConstants.MIN_REQUIRED_R_SQUARED;
018import static paint.shared.constants.PaintStringConstants.MIN_REQUIRED_DENSITY_RATIO;
019import static paint.shared.constants.PaintStringConstants.MAX_ALLOWABLE_VARIABILITY;
020import static paint.shared.constants.PaintStringConstants.GENERATE_SQUARES;
021import static paint.shared.constants.PaintStringConstants.TRACKMATE;
022import static paint.shared.constants.PaintStringConstants.RUN_GENERATE_SQUARES_AFTER;
023
024import static paint.ui.dialogs.ProjectDialog.DialogMode;
025
026/**
027 * Panel that displays all the configuration parameters required for the "Generate Squares" step.
028 * In TRACKMATE mode, a checkbox allows configuring whether to run Generate Squares automatically
029 * after TrackMate processing. The panel allows changes, exposes a callback for any parameter
030 * modification, and supports persistence of these settings back to PaintConfig.
031 */
032public class SquaresParamsPanel {
033
034    private final JPanel            panel = new JPanel(new GridBagLayout());
035    private       JCheckBox         runAfterTrackMate;
036    private final JComboBox<String> gridSizeCombo;
037    private final JTextField        minRSqField;
038    private final JTextField        minDensityField;
039    private final JTextField        maxVariabilityField;
040
041    private final JLabel            gridSizeLabel;
042    private final JLabel            minRSqLabel;
043    private final JLabel            minDensityLabel;
044    private final JLabel            maxVariabilityLabel;
045
046    private final Color             normalLabelColor;
047    private final Color             disabledLabelColor = Color.GRAY;
048
049    // Whether the Generate Squares fields as a whole are enabled (TRACKMATE mode checkbox, dialog state).
050    private boolean                 squaresEnabled = true;
051
052    // Callback triggered whenever any user-editable parameter changes.
053    private Runnable onChange = () -> {
054    };
055
056    /**
057     * Constructs the panel and initializes fields based on PaintConfig and dialog mode.
058     */
059    public SquaresParamsPanel(DialogMode mode) {
060
061        panel.setBorder(new TitledBorder("Generate Squares Parameters"));
062        final GridBagConstraints pg = new GridBagConstraints();
063        pg.insets  = new Insets(5,5,5,5);
064        pg.anchor  = GridBagConstraints.WEST;
065        pg.fill    = GridBagConstraints.NONE;
066
067        // Load defaults from configuration
068        int nrSquares   = PaintConfig.getInt(   GENERATE_SQUARES, NUMBER_OF_SQUARES_IN_RECORDING, 400);
069        double minRSq   = PaintConfig.getDouble(GENERATE_SQUARES, MIN_REQUIRED_R_SQUARED,         0.1);
070        double minDens  = PaintConfig.getDouble(GENERATE_SQUARES, MIN_REQUIRED_DENSITY_RATIO,     2.0);
071        double maxVar   = PaintConfig.getDouble(GENERATE_SQUARES, MAX_ALLOWABLE_VARIABILITY,      10.0);
072
073        int row = 0;
074
075        // TRACKMATE mode: checkbox to run Generate Squares after TrackMate completes
076        if (mode == DialogMode.TRACKMATE_BATCH) {
077            runAfterTrackMate = new JCheckBox(
078                    "Run Generate Squares after TrackMate",
079                    PaintConfig.getBoolean(TRACKMATE, RUN_GENERATE_SQUARES_AFTER, false)
080            );
081            pg.gridx = 0; pg.gridy = row; pg.gridwidth = 2;
082            panel.add(runAfterTrackMate, pg);
083            row++;
084            pg.gridwidth = 1;
085
086            runAfterTrackMate.addActionListener(e -> {
087                setSquaresEnabled(runAfterTrackMate.isSelected());
088                onChange.run();
089            });
090        }
091
092        final Dimension labelSize = new Dimension(220, 20);
093        final Dimension fieldSize = new Dimension(80, 24);
094
095        pg.gridx = 0;
096        pg.gridy = row;
097        gridSizeLabel = label(panel, NUMBER_OF_SQUARES_IN_RECORDING, labelSize, pg);
098        pg.gridx = 1;
099        gridSizeCombo = new JComboBox<>(new String[]{"1x1", "5x5", "10x10", "15x15", "20x20", "25x25", "30x30", "35x35", "40x40"});
100        int n = (int) Math.sqrt(nrSquares);
101        gridSizeCombo.setSelectedItem(n + "x" + n);
102        panel.add(gridSizeCombo, pg);
103        row++;
104
105        // Min R²
106        pg.gridx = 0;
107        pg.gridy = row;
108        minRSqLabel = label(panel, "Min Required R²", labelSize, pg);
109        pg.gridx = 1;
110        minRSqField = text(String.valueOf(minRSq), fieldSize);
111        panel.add(minRSqField, pg);
112        row++;
113
114        // Min Density Ratio
115        pg.gridx = 0;
116        pg.gridy = row;
117        minDensityLabel = label(panel, MIN_REQUIRED_DENSITY_RATIO, labelSize, pg);
118        pg.gridx = 1;
119        minDensityField = text(String.valueOf(minDens), fieldSize);
120        panel.add(minDensityField, pg);
121        row++;
122
123        // Max Variability
124        pg.gridx = 0;
125        pg.gridy = row;
126        maxVariabilityLabel = label(panel, MAX_ALLOWABLE_VARIABILITY, labelSize, pg);
127        pg.gridx = 1;
128        maxVariabilityField = text(String.valueOf(maxVar), fieldSize);
129        panel.add(maxVariabilityField, pg);
130
131        normalLabelColor = gridSizeLabel.getForeground();
132
133        // Change listeners for all controls (REPLACED WITH METHOD REFERENCES)
134        gridSizeCombo.addActionListener(e -> setSquaresEnabled(squaresEnabled));
135        gridSizeCombo.addActionListener(this::handleChange);
136        minRSqField.getDocument().addDocumentListener((SimpleDocumentListener) this::handleChange);
137        minDensityField.getDocument().addDocumentListener((SimpleDocumentListener) this::handleChange);
138        maxVariabilityField.getDocument().addDocumentListener((SimpleDocumentListener) this::handleChange);
139
140        // Initial enable state: TRACKMATE mode checkbox, and the 1x1 grid
141        setSquaresEnabled(mode != DialogMode.TRACKMATE_BATCH || runAfterTrackMate.isSelected());
142    }
143
144    /**
145     * Returns the Swing component associated with this panel.
146     */
147    public JPanel component() {
148        return panel;
149    }
150
151    /**
152     * Registers a callback that fires whenever any parameter changes.
153     * If null is passed, it resets to a no-op callback.
154     */
155    public void onParamsChanged(Runnable runnable) {
156        this.onChange = (runnable != null ? runnable : () -> {
157        });
158    }
159
160    /**
161     * Enables or disables the panel. When in TRACKMATE mode, the Generate Squares fields
162     * respect both the main enabled flag and the state of the "Run after TrackMate" checkbox.
163     */
164    public void setEnabled(boolean enabled) {
165
166        if (runAfterTrackMate != null) {
167            runAfterTrackMate.setEnabled(enabled);
168        }
169
170        boolean squaresEnabled = enabled && (runAfterTrackMate == null || runAfterTrackMate.isSelected());
171
172        setSquaresEnabled(squaresEnabled);
173    }
174
175    /**
176     * Persists the current field values to PaintConfig and saves the configuration.
177     */
178    public void persistTo(DialogMode mode) {
179        if (gridSizeCombo != null) {
180            String selectedItem = (String) gridSizeCombo.getSelectedItem();
181            if (selectedItem != null && selectedItem.contains("x")) {
182                int side = Integer.parseInt(selectedItem.split("x")[0].trim());
183                PaintConfig.setInt(GENERATE_SQUARES, NUMBER_OF_SQUARES_IN_RECORDING, side * side);
184            }
185        }
186        if (minRSqField != null) {
187            PaintConfig.setDouble(GENERATE_SQUARES, MIN_REQUIRED_R_SQUARED,
188                                  parseDouble(minRSqField.getText(), 0.1));
189        }
190        if (minDensityField != null) {
191            PaintConfig.setDouble(GENERATE_SQUARES, MIN_REQUIRED_DENSITY_RATIO,
192                                  parseDouble(minDensityField.getText(), 2.0));
193        }
194        if (maxVariabilityField != null) {
195            PaintConfig.setDouble(GENERATE_SQUARES, MAX_ALLOWABLE_VARIABILITY ,
196                                  parseDouble(maxVariabilityField.getText(), 10.0));
197        }
198        if (mode == DialogMode.TRACKMATE_BATCH && runAfterTrackMate != null) {
199            PaintConfig.setBoolean(TRACKMATE, RUN_GENERATE_SQUARES_AFTER, runAfterTrackMate.isSelected());
200        }
201        PaintConfig.instance().save();
202    }
203
204    /**
205     * Adds a fixed-size label into the GridBag container.
206     */
207    private static JLabel label(JPanel jPanel, String text, Dimension size, GridBagConstraints pg) {
208        JLabel jLabel = new JLabel(text);
209        jLabel.setPreferredSize(size);
210        jPanel.add(jLabel, pg);
211        return jLabel;
212    }
213
214    /**
215     * Builds a fixed-size text field initialized to a given value.
216     */
217    private static JTextField text(String v, Dimension size) {
218        JTextField jTextField = new JTextField(v);
219        jTextField.setColumns(8);
220        jTextField.setPreferredSize(size);
221        return jTextField;
222    }
223
224    /**
225     * Enables or disables all the Generate Squares fields (grid size, R², density, variability).
226     * With a 1x1 grid, density ratio and variability stay disabled: Generate Squares then uses
227     * fixed values for them (see {@code GenerateSquaresConfig.isWholeScreen()}).
228     */
229    public void setSquaresEnabled(boolean enabled) {
230        this.squaresEnabled = enabled;
231        boolean selectionCriteriaEnabled = enabled && !"1x1".equals(gridSizeCombo.getSelectedItem());
232
233        gridSizeCombo.setEnabled(enabled);
234        minRSqField.setEnabled(enabled);
235        minDensityField.setEnabled(selectionCriteriaEnabled);
236        maxVariabilityField.setEnabled(selectionCriteriaEnabled);
237
238        gridSizeLabel.setForeground(enabled ? normalLabelColor : disabledLabelColor);
239        minRSqLabel.setForeground(enabled ? normalLabelColor : disabledLabelColor);
240        minDensityLabel.setForeground(selectionCriteriaEnabled ? normalLabelColor : disabledLabelColor);
241        maxVariabilityLabel.setForeground(selectionCriteriaEnabled ? normalLabelColor : disabledLabelColor);
242    }
243
244    /**
245     * Parses a double from string with fallback to a default on error.
246     */
247    private static double parseDouble(String doubleString, double def) {
248        try {
249            return Double.parseDouble(doubleString.trim());
250        } catch (Exception e) {
251            return def;
252        }
253    }
254
255    // ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
256    // Added overloaded event handlers for method references (NO formatting changed above)
257    // ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
258
259    @SuppressWarnings("unused")
260    private void handleChange(java.awt.event.ActionEvent e) {
261        onChange.run();
262    }
263
264    @SuppressWarnings("unused")
265    private void handleChange(javax.swing.event.DocumentEvent e) {
266        onChange.run();
267    }
268
269    public boolean isRunAfterTrackMateSelected() {
270        return runAfterTrackMate != null && runAfterTrackMate.isSelected();
271    }
272}
